Agents for Debtors

REGULATORS – AI agents help regulators monitor compliance, track insolvency cases, and identify potential fraudulent activities. They generate real-time reports and alerts on procedural delays or violations. This ensures a more transparent and accountable insolvency ecosystem.

AFA Compliance Agent – A digital platform that allows creditors to submit their claims in insolvency proceedings seamlessly. It automates document verification, claim categorization, and submission tracking. This reduces paperwork and ensures faster claim processing.

Timeline Compliance Agent – Concise, visually engaging documents that highlight key financial and operational details of distressed businesses. These are shared with potential investors to gauge interest in acquiring or restructuring the entity. They help attract bidders in the insolvency resolution process.

Public Comments Agent – AI-driven assistants designed to automate and optimize various aspects of insolvency resolution, such as claim verification, fraud detection, and investor outreach. They use predictive analytics to enhance recovery strategies and compliance monitoring. These agents improve efficiency and transparency in the insolvency process.

Moratorium Monitoring Agent – Structured templates powered by AI agents to assist insolvency professionals in organizing financial data, claims, and compliance tasks. These worksheets provide automated insights, risk assessments, and document generation. They streamline decision-making and reduce manual errors.

Plan Compliance Agent – Structured templates powered by AI agents to assist insolvency professionals in organizing financial data, claims, and compliance tasks. These worksheets provide automated insights, risk assessments, and document generation. They streamline decision-making and reduce manual errors.
